description: This file defines a data access layer for device management, providing a 'DeviceRepository' class that performs CRUD operations on a MongoDB collection using 'pymongo'. It encapsulates database interactions, manages device documents, and offers a factory function for repository creation.

classes.name: DeviceRepository
classes.description: Provides CRUD operations for device documents stored in a MongoDB collection, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting devices.

methods.name: None __init__(self, collection: Collection)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a MongoDB collection and ensures a unique index on 'name'.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_devices(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all devices, excluding internal MongoDB '_id' fields.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_device(self, name: str)
methods.description: Fetches a device document by its unique name.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[Dict[str,Any]],Optional[str]] create_device(self, device: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts a new device document into the collection, handling duplicate key errors.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[Dict[str,Any]],Optional[str]] update_device(self, name: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an existing device identified by name.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,Optional[str]] delete_device(self, name: str)
methods.description: Deletes a device document by name.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _strip_id(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Removes the '_id' field from a MongoDB document before returning.

methods.name: DeviceRepository create_repository(mongo_uri: str, db_name: str, collection_name: str)
methods.description: Factory function to create and connect a 'DeviceRepository' given MongoDB connection details.
